confirmed_segment_rules.position_curve: quadratic Bezier over start, control, end absolute positions
confirmed_segment_rules.lane_curve: quadratic Bezier over start, control, end lane positions
confirmed_segment_rules.position_quantization: truncate to quantum bucket and add one quantum when the integer remainder is at least 1.5
confirmed_segment_rules.endpoint_filter: discard samples quantized exactly to start or end; retain repeated internal quantized positions
confirmed_segment_rules.right_control: start lane < control lane and end lane < control lane
confirmed_segment_rules.multi_range_right_control: add width - 1 to start and end lanes before lane interpolation

confirmed_sequence_rules.triplet_scan: adjacent sliding windows start, control, end
confirmed_sequence_rules.acceptance: start and end resolve to the same Slide A/B family and middle is one of eight control WAVs
confirmed_sequence_rules.force_front: move before the first earlier-position Slide A/B note
confirmed_sequence_rules.force_back: move after the last later-position Slide A/B note
confirmed_sequence_rules.score_line: group by #bar lane prefix, expand to the maximum reduced denominator, write 00 for empty slots

confirmed_postprocess_rules.duplicate_merge: average LaneAbsolutePos and reconstruct BezierNoteTempData from the first member metadata
confirmed_postprocess_rules.constant_diff_reduction: remove the middle point when previous, current, and next DiffVolume are equal
confirmed_postprocess_rules.angular_reduction: remove the middle point when adjacent atan2 angle difference times 57.296 is less than 2.0 degrees
confirmed_postprocess_rules.consecutive_anchor: consecutive removals retain the last non-removed point as the previous anchor
confirmed_postprocess_rules.multi_range_support: width 2..N creates lane offsets away from the retained edge; right-control subtracts and left-control adds
confirmed_postprocess_rules.same_position_dedup: line prefix, absolute position, and bar number identify an already materialized NoteData
